verses.en: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.
verses.sm: O le tu i mea faaleagaga i le ekalesia i la outou tausisi i le alofa; ia naunau foi i nisi mea alofa faaleagaga, a e maise lava ia mafai e outou ona perofeta ane.

verses.en: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth him; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries.
verses.sm: Aua o lé tautala i le gagana uiga ese, e le tautala ia i tagata, a o le Atua; aua e leai se lagona, a e tautala ia i le Agaga i mea Wo;

verses.en: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.
verses.sm: a o le perofeta .ane, e tautala ia i tagata, ina ia faamafanafana ai, ma apoapoai ai, ma fetomai ai.

verses.en: He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.
verses.sm: O lé tautala i le gagana uiga ese e faamafanafana e ia ia te ia; a o le perofeta ane, e faamafanafana ia i le ekalesia.

verses.en: I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.
verses.sm: Ou te loto ina ia outou tautala uma i gagana uiga ese, a e sili lo‘u loto ina ia outou perofeta ane; aua e sili lē perofeta ane i le tautala i gagana uiga ese, vagana ua faamatalaina ina ia faamafanafanaina le ekalesia.

verses.en: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?
verses.sm: A o lenei, le au uso e , afai ou te alu atu ia te outou ma tautala i gagana ese, se a ea sou aoga ia te outou, pe afai ou te le tautala atu ia te outou i le faaaliga, po o le malamalama, po o le perofeta ane, po o le a“oa“o atu?

verses.en: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?
verses.sm: O mea foi e le ola ua taalili mai leo, po o le fagufagu, po o le kitara, a lē fefatifatiai leo, e iloa ea faapefea le mea ua ilia mai, po o le mea ua taia mai?

verses.en: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?
verses.sm: Aua foi a faaletonu le leo o le pu, o ai ea se na te sauni e tau!

verses.en: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.
verses.sm: E faapea foi outou, afai tou te le sauniuni atu i o outou laulaufaiva ni upu matala, e iloa ea faapefea le upu ua tautala ai? Aua e tautala atu outou i le gaogao.

verses.en: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.
verses.sm: Atonu e tele lava leo i le lalolagi, a e tofu ma lona uiga. Ir O lenei, afai ou te le iloa le uiga o le leo,

verses.en: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.
verses.sm: ua avea aʻu ma tagata o le nuu ese i le tautala mai; o lé tautala mai foi, o le tagata o le nuu ese o ia ia te au.

verses.en: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.
verses.sm: la faapea foi outou, ina ua outou naunau i mea alofa faaleagaga, sailiili ia ina ia sili outou i le faamafanafanaina O le ekalesia.

verses.en: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.
verses.sm: O lenei, o 1e tautala i le gagana uiga ese, ina tatalo ia o ia, ina ia mafai ona faamatalaina e ia.

verses.en: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.
verses.sm: Aua afai ou te tatalo i le gagana uiga ese, ua tatalo ai lo'u agaga, a ua le fua mai ni fua e loʻu mafaufau.

verses.en: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
verses.sm: Ia, a faapefea? ou te tatalo i le agaga, ou te tatalo foi i le mafaufau; ou te pese i le agaga, ou te pese foi i le mafaufau.

verses.en: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?
verses.sm: A le faapea, pe a E faafetai i le agaga, pe faapefea ona amene mai i lau faamanú o lē nofo i le mea e nofo ai le tagata le aoaoina, ina ua le lagona e ia lau upu?

verses.en: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.
verses.sm: aua ua mālie lava lau faamanîi, a ua le faamafanafanaina le tasi.

verses.en: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:
verses.sm: Ou te faafetai i loʻu Atua, ina ua tele laʻu tautala i gagana eseese, a e itiiti a outou uma lava;

verses.en: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
verses.sm: a e peitai ou te loto ina ia ou tautala i le ekalesia i ni upu se lima ma loʻu mafaufau, ina ia ou aʻoaʻo atu i nisi, a e ou te le loto i ni upu se mano i se gagana ese.

verses.en: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.
verses.sm: Le au uso e, aua tou te faatamaiti i le mafaufau; ia outou faatamameamea i le leaga, a ia outou tagata matutua i le mafaufau.

verses.en: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.
verses.sm: Ua tusia i le tulafono, Ua fetalai mai le Alii, Qu te tautala atu i lenei nuu i gagara eseese ma laugutu ese; a e ui lava ina faapea, latou te le faalogo mai lava ia te au.

verses.en: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.
verses.sm: O lenei, o gagana eseese, e le fai ma faailoga ia i e faatuatua, a o e le faatuatua; a o le perofeta ane, e le se faailoga lea mo e le faatuatua, a o e faatuatua.

verses.en: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?
verses.sm: Afai foi e faapotopoto le ekalesia uma ma latou tautala uma i gagana uiga ese, a ulufale. atu ni tagata le aoaoina, po o e le faatuatua, e le taʻuvaleleaina ca outou e i latou?

verses.en: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:
verses.sm: A e afai e perofeta ane uma, a e ulufale atu se tasi, o se le faatuatua, po o se tagata le aoaoina, ua aoaiina o ia e i latou uma, ua faamasinoina e i latou uma,

verses.en: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.
verses.sm: ua aliali mai ai foi mea lilo o i lona loto, ona faapaú Ғa6 ai lea o ia, ma ifo atu i le Atua, ma talatala, e moni, o ia te outou le Atua.

verses.en: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.
verses.sm: O lenei, le au uso e, pe faapefea? Pe a outou potopoto, ua tofu outou mia le pese, ua i ai le mataupu, ua i ai le gagana, ua i ai le faaaliga, ua i ai le faamatalaga; ia faia mea uma e iu ai i le faamafanafanaina.

verses.en: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.
verses.sm: Afai e tautala se tasi i le gagana ese, ia tautala se toalua, po o se toatolu e gata ai, ma ia feauai; ma ia faamatala e se tasi.

verses.en: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
verses.sm: A e afai e leai se na te faamatalaina, aua le tautala o ia i le ekalesia; a ia tautala o ia ia te ia ma le Atua.

verses.en: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.
verses.sm: Ia tautala perofeta e toalua, pe toatolu, ma ia faamasinoina E nisi.

verses.en: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.
verses.sm: A e afai ua faaalia se mea i se tasi o loo nofo mai, ia faalologo le na muamua.

verses.en: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.
verses.sm: Auā tou te mafaia ona perofeta uma taitoatasi, ina ia aʻoaʻoina uma, ma ia faamafanafanaina uma.

verses.en: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.
verses.sm: E usiusitai foi agaga o perofeta i perofeta.

verses.en: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
verses.sm: Aua o le Atua, e le o le Atua ia o le faasoesa, a o le filemu E faapei o ekalesia uma o le au paia,

verses.en: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.
verses.sm: aua neʻi tautala fafine i ekalesia. Auā e le tuuina ia te i latou e tautala; a ia latou usiusitai, pei ona fai mai ai foi o le tulafono.

verses.en: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.
verses.sm: Afai foi ua latou fia iloa se tasi mea, ia latou fesili atu ai i a latou lava tane i o latou fale; auā o le mea matagā ona tautala o le fafine i le ekalesia.

verses.en: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?
verses.sm: Na alu atu ea le upu a le Atua nai ia te outou? Po ua na o outou ea na oo atu i ai?

verses.en: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.
verses.sm: Ai se tasi ua taʻua o le perofeta, po o le ua i ai le Agaga, ia iloa lelei e ia, o mea du te tusi atu nei ia te outou, o poloaiga ia a le Alii.

verses.en: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.
verses.sm: A e afai e tetee lenei mea e se tasi, e teena foi o ia.

verses.en: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.
verses.sm: O lenei, le au uso e, ia outou naunau ina ia perofeta; aua foi neʻi vavao le tautala i gagana uiga ese.

verses.en: Let all things be done decently and in order.
verses.sm: Ia faia mea uma lava ma le matagofie ma le sauni lelei.
